value.0: Huh?  Haven't you heard?  I can't believe you came all this way to Hightop City and did not know...

It is the Duke's doing.  You see, in recent years the lands around us have grown more and more dangerous.  The Duke thinks there is some force guiding it, though others think we simply live in more dangerous time.

Whatever the truth of it is, the Duke decided to spread agents throughout the lands and investigate this evil.  You will find many of these agents in the surrounding areas selling potions and occassionally giving out quests to adventurers such as yourself.

This is where the Duke's idea comes in.  He uses the agents to gather information about adventurers, grading them as it were on their deeds and assigning quest points to their victories.

He then pays me to enchant an item for them.  The more quest points an adventurer has gathered, the more powerful enchantment I can place on the item.

The Duke hopes this will do two things.  First, it lures... err, persuades adventurers to come to this area and help clear out the danger.  Also, should any of the adventurers find what is behind the dangers they might have the magic to defeat them.
Quest points measure your reputation based on the good deeds you have done for us.  Based on your reputation, I will use my skills as an enchantress to enchant a magical item for you.
You do not have enough quest points to purchase anything right now...
Well I can hardly fashion you some great enchantments on it if you don't have it...
First I must fashion you a weapon.  Choose what you would like...
I am busy right now, please come back later.
Ah, <FirstName>, are you here to have an item made from the shards of the Sword of Narsis?
Very good.  What type of item would you like?
Why would you make magic items for free when you could sell them for a lot of gold?
Oh, I knew, I was just testing you.  Mmm, I think I'll browse over here...
How many quest points do I have?
I would like to spend my quest points...
Nevermind, I'll come back later and specify.
